content.title: Humble Gamble
about: Humble Gamble is a VR prototype developed as part of a university VR project.
The main focus was learning and applying VR interaction patterns (hands/controllers, diegetic UI, and player comfort considerations).
The project served as my first practical VR development experience in a team environment.
features: VR interaction prototypes using motion controllers
World-space UI and feedback designed for VR readability
learnings: VR interaction patterns and comfort constraints
Diegetic UI and spatial feedback design
Testing and iterating VR experiences with users
